Program Kit 0.1.0-alpha.2
Usage: program-kit <command> [arguments] [options]

Commands:
  artifacts inspect  Inspect and validate one explicit Program Kit artifact without changing it.
  capabilities catalog  Show release availability, role, registration, and freshness separately.
  capabilities initialize  Initialize or refresh thin provider wrappers from this installed CLI.
  capabilities preflight  Verify one capability's complete installed knowledge closure and active registration.
  capabilities read  Return one ready capability's exact canonical Markdown bytes.
  capabilities read-resource  Return one allow-listed supporting resource at exact packaged bytes.
  capabilities render-catalog  Render the repository authoring capability index.
  capabilities verify-bundle  Verify one content-only CapabilityBundle package.
  check  Run one finite Program Kit check profile.
  commands describe  Describe one finite backed Program Kit command.
  csharp-gate bind  Bind an exact C# gate selection.
  csharp-gate describe-definition  Describe gate-definition schemas, conditions, order keys, and public analyzer selections.
  csharp-gate materialize-definition  Validate and canonicalize one complete gate-definition draft.
  csharp-gate render-definition  Render one valid C# gate definition.
  csharp-gate scaffold  Scaffold an explicitly selected consumer analyzer.
  csharp-gate scaffold-lock  Scaffold one complete digest-bound C# gate bind request.
  csharp-gate validate-definition  Validate one canonical C# gate definition.
  csharp-gate verify  Verify an exact C# gate execution request.
  diagnostics explain  Explain ownership, evidence, remediation, and stop behavior for a diagnostic.
  digest  Compute the canonical JSON SHA-256 digest of one artifact.
  dotnet describe-console-contract  Describe the exact supported Open Console authoring and binding contract.
  dotnet generate-client  Generate one pinned Kiota client from explicit inputs.
  dotnet generate-host  Generate one API, Console, or worker .NET host.
  dotnet 
[truncated]
